name: Self-written connectors
note: Agent writes its own API client
summary: Instead of installing a connector, the agent reads an API's docs and writes its own small client or script, then runs it in a sandbox or shell. Anthropic describes a related approach where MCP servers are presented as code APIs that the agent calls from code rather than as direct tool calls.
facts: Code execution and a place to keep credentials
~150K to ~2K tokens in Anthropic's code-execution example (vendor-reported)
Any API works, but no managed auth or vetted tools
how: Agent reads the API docs or OpenAPI spec
Writes a small client or script for the calls it needs
Runs it with credentials from the environment or a secrets store
Saves working scripts as reusable tools or skills
goodFor: Processing large data outside the model's context
watchOut: Agent-written code can mishandle credentials or make destructive calls
You maintain the generated clients when APIs change
